question: How vital is change management and user adoption for successful Source2Pay implementations?
transcript_excerpt: Change management is absolutely critical—even the most powerful solution will fall short if users do not embrace it. True success goes far beyond traditional training; it requires meeting users where they are with contextual in-app guidance and simplifying workflows. Building internal change champions and securing genuine top-down buy-in makes the new path the path of least resistance.
